title: SO FLUFFY
cue: fur on any mesh: animals, mascots, moss, rugs; it bounces
summary: Shell fur on any mesh: a Fur node grows strands with length, density, curls, a color gradient along each strand, and springy physics that makes the fur swing when its owner moves.
useWhen: A hero creature, pet, mascot, or monster should look furry from near, or a rug, moss, or a pom-pom should be soft: one or two such things on screen, where their fur is what the player looks at.
avoidWhen: Many furry things at once or far from the camera, where a fur texture reads the same: every shell draws the mesh again, 16 to 48 times.
